As a Product Engineer on the Grok Connectors team at SpaceXAI, you'll build the integrations that let Grok, Cursor and Grok Bot do real work inside the tools people use every day: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar and Drive, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, GitHub, Slack, finance accounts, and a fast-growing marketplace of third-party MCP plugins. You'll architect, implement, and deploy features end to end, from OAuth sign-in and token handling, to tool schemas and reliability across hundreds of millions of tool calls, to the cards and approval flows users see on web, desktop, and mobile. You'll work directly with enterprise customers and partners to ship connectors that large organizations can trust.




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You have an entrepreneurial spirit and love creating outsized business impact.

 - You let data decide what to work on. You size user impact from logs and metrics, and you measure error rates before and after every fix.

 - You're strong in TypeScript and comfortable shipping across backend services and client UI in a large codebase.

About the Job We build and operate large-scale web crawling and extraction systems that turn unstructured, dynamic websites into clean, structured and correct data. You'll own crawlers end-to-end: discovery, resilient fetching against real anti-bot defenses, and turning HTML/PDF into trustworthy structured output.

 What you will do 
 Build and scale crawlers that handle dynamic, large-scale sites, and keep them running as those sites change and fight back. Stay ahead of anti-bot measures: TLS/browser fingerprinting, proxies, session and rate-limit strategy, and change detection. Turn raw HTML and PDF into clean, correct structured data (including LLM-assisted extraction), where silently wrong output is worse than a crash. Design and operate pipelines for ingestion, deduplication, versioning and enrichment. Ship and run containerized apps in the cloud, with CI/CD. Shape our technical architecture and engineering culture. 

 Our Tech Stack Python, Docker, GCP (Cloud Run jobs), Azure Blob Storage, MongoDB. Go services and a React frontend on the periphery. You don't need all of it on day one, but you do need to ramp up fast.

 Your profile 3+ years of professional software development (5+ for the senior track). Strong Python: real production code, async. Hands-on web scraping at scale, including firsthand experience with anti-bot defenses and the failure modes of large-scale collection. A data-correctness mindset: you care that extracted data is right, not just that the job finished. Docker, at least one major cloud (GCP, Azure or AWS), Git and comfort on the CLI. A clear communicator who works well in a small, fast-moving team. Nice to have:
 LLM-assisted extraction or other work with LLMs, ML pipelines or data labeling workflows. Go or Java/Spring Boot. Frontend (React), or eagerness to pick it up. Terraform, Kubernetes and modern DevOps tooling. 

 Why us? A vibrant in-office culture in Munich, with the option to work from home up to 60% of the time.
